title: Personalized MC
description: Feel the Vibes of Old Minecraft
body:
When we were kids Minecraft felt **HUGE** and Cool. So i fixed it and actually made it **HUGE** and **COOL**. This modpack is manily for **low-performance** laptop gamers like me so we can have that feeling again without our PC's blowing up.
If you wanna see mod reviews, guides and more check out:
[https://www.youtube.com/@Darklightningc](https://www.youtube.com/@Darklightningc)
